text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If there's one thing local idols have
in
spades, it's spirit! Teach me all there is
to know
about boxing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho, that's the spirit. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, Acute? Did you... switch into a
higher gear?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Those punches looked really powerful...
I was
honestly a little shocked...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I now? I guess I didn't even
realize.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (But if she's telling the truth, then...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps all of Trainer's diligent
guidance is
starting to bear fruit.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like I'll have to express my
gratitude.
